common_rule.policy: Use every original P4 h3 point/weight, adopted-P4 denominator per parameter. Re-evaluate higher-quadrature coefficient states on this rule; preserve existing higher-rule comparison separately. No masking, pressure shifting or remeshing the shared training mesh.

cost.purpose: conservative allocation planning from actual phase evidence

measured_cache_projection.future_parameter_variation: 25 percent contingency and hard campaign stop; no assertion all Re share identical iteration counts

rules: No fit budget reset or extra seed/architecture search
Measured source/data/retention review required before any release
Unused reference headroom does not enlarge the conditional ROM cap
A runtime cap hit requires review, not automatic retry
All prior native capacity/replay allocations are infrastructure; no trained ROM executed

population_schedule_proposal.condition: Setup/finalization must fit reserved overhead; reduce runner by actual elapsed setup if needed. No automatic retry over either cap.

hard_allocation_reservations.condition: Setup/finalization must fit reserved overhead; reduce runner by actual elapsed setup if needed. No automatic retry over either cap.

critical_cost_work.status: source preparation next; no repeated baseline solve required

critical_cost_work.status: requires exact numerical/retention packages and coordinator release

disk.policy: Current full-expanded-plus-archive-plus-chunks retention is too expensive for the whole population. Before population release, review archive-only lossless retention with pinned commit/chunk/member hashes, explicit recovery, and temporary rehydration; no Git history rewrite/pruning, no unique evidence deletion, no assumed dedup gain. Keep at most a bounded current batch warm; immutable inputs/dependencies need not be recopied into every future archive if their exact recoverable source is pinned and verified.

coefficient_primary_proposal.status: native proof passed; independent audit and exact population retention implementation pending
coefficient_primary_proposal.large_audit_arrays: one complete archived copy, no duplicate individual Git blobs; all raw Jacobian/force/noise evidence preserved
coefficient_primary_proposal.warm_runtime: exact coefficients, mesh/layout, immutable native/common-rule cache and metadata; materialize preparation full fields explicitly
coefficient_primary_proposal.shared_closure: one verified immutable geometry/environment content closure; exact duplicate bytes can be reused only with explicit manifest recovery
coefficient_primary_proposal.derived_fields: numerically reproducible on demand, not claimed bitwise-identical historical ZIP containers
coefficient_primary_proposal.actual_unique_byte_projection: to be calculated from verified collected proof before population release
